bullets.text: Curbing Fibre Rollout Obstacles - The UK government aims to tackle freeholder issues hindering gigabit broadband access to flats.
AI-Driven Telecom Growth - **HCLTech** acquires **HPE**'s Telco Solutions to enhance AI-led network automation.
Wi-Fi 8 Solutions Launched - **Broadcom** introduces Wi-Fi 8, with testing support from **Rohde & Schwarz**.
6G Innovations Ahead - **Keysight** predicts 6G will embed intelligence directly into the radio layer, reshaping network design.
Geospatial Analytics Revolution - Geospatial data is transforming telecom network planning and operational efficiency.
Agentic AI in Telecom - **Huawei** emphasizes the role of AI agents in enhancing operational efficiency and revenue streams.
Activation Over Coverage - The broadband industry shifts focus from 'homes passed' to network activation and user experience.
2026 Predictions Unveiled - Experts outline key trends shaping telecom, including AI integration and satellite connectivity.
